chartbook.title: The Economic Status of Minnesotans 2026: A Chartbook with Data for Minnesota's Largest Cultural Groups
chartbook.dataSource: Census Bureau American Community Survey, 2019 to 2023 combined five-year sample, tabulated by the Demographic Center from the University of Minnesota's Integrated Public Use Microdata Series, USA version 16.0 (2025).
chartbook.geography: Statewide only. The report says its group sizes are too small for county or regional detail.

disabilityBrief.title: Minnesotans with Disabilities: Demographic and Economic Characteristics
disabilityBrief.dataSource: Census Bureau American Community Survey, 2019 to 2023, using the same cultural groups as the 2026 chartbook.

suppressionRules: A cultural group appears in the report only if it had 300 or more survey respondents in the 2019 to 2023 sample.
A value is not shown when fewer than 150 survey respondents are in the group of people that value describes. The report prints NA, and marks the group with an asterisk.
All values are rounded. Groups may not add up to the total because of rounding and values not shown.
Margins of error are at the 95 percent confidence level. They are generally larger for smaller groups.
comparabilityNote: Do not compare these figures with the 2023 edition of this report. The 2023 edition used 2016 to 2020 survey data, which overlaps with the 2019 to 2023 data used here, and the Census Bureau cautions against comparing overlapping five-year samples.
periodNote: The figures are averages over January 2019 to December 2023, a period that includes the economic disruption of the COVID-19 pandemic.
readingNote: Values are counts and medians exactly as printed in the report tables, with their margins of error. The report's tables print counts, not percentages, so no percentages are given here except the share of Minnesota's population printed in Table ii. Where a measure is a count of people, universeCount is the printed number of people the count is out of.

disabilityBrief.figure: Figure 6a. Number of People with at Least One Disability, by Cultural Group, 2019-2023
disabilityBrief.universe: Residents ages 18 to 64 (civilian, not living in institutions)
disabilityBrief.marginOfErrorNote: The brief draws 95 percent margins of error as error bars but does not print them as numbers, so none are given here.
disabilityBrief.definitionNote: Same cultural groups and survey years as the chartbook. The brief prints counts for some groups that the chartbook does not show because of small samples (Somali, Karen, Puerto Rican, Ethiopian, Korean, Lao, Liberian, Dakota, Filipino). Treat those with extra caution. It gives no count for Other American Indian, Other Asian, Other Black, Other Hispanic, White, Other (including Pacific Islander), Multiple Cultural Groups or the total.
disabilityBrief.excluded: Figures 6b and 6c (percent with a disability, ages 18 to 44 and 45 to 64) are not used. Their printed percentages sit at the end of each error bar and do not match the length of the drawn bars (for example, Dakota is printed as 40.2 percent but its bar ends near 26 percent), so the estimate cannot be read reliably. Neither figure gives a rate for ages 18 to 64.
